contract.causality: Features use fixed accepted prefixes; whole-file decoding remains offline preparation
contract.cost: Whole-file decode and extraction CPU included; CPU is not joules; prior acquisition separate

features.audio: 32 log-mel means followed by 32 standard deviations
features.normalization: none in preparation; any fitted normalization uses train only
features.text: mean token one-hot; a linear projection is a learned mean embedding
features.video: top-left 8x8 orthonormal DCT of a 16x16 grayscale frame

contract.holdout: test preparation requires a saved candidate-freeze artifact; no test-based selection
contract.inference: weighted accuracy; cluster uncertainty by actor, retaining emotion groups
contract.scope: Two-sentence acted AV/text consistency; not open-domain or foundation-model validation
transcripts: I'm on my way to the meeting

windows.audio: native preceding half-second cropped before window-local resampling to 8000 samples
windows.origin: max(audio stream start, first video timestamp)
windows.video: last original frame at or before cutoff
